title: 第9章 逆转舆论截杀萧霓凰第10章 四皇子很了不起么
slug: 我纨绔世子开局征服太子妃
content_zh:
咔嚓！
一道清脆又刺耳的骨裂声，在死寂的王府门前突兀响起。
姜峰刚吐出一个字，声音便戛然而止。
他双目暴突，眼球几乎要从眶中挤出，其间写满了惊骇与不解。
只见楚天渊那只布满厚茧、仿佛枯树皮般的大手，正死死掐着他的脖子。
那只手看起来苍老，却蕴含着山岳般不可撼动的力量，轻而易举地捏碎了他的喉骨。
嘭！
楚天渊手臂一振，随手将姜峰的尸体扔在地上，发出一声闷响，那具尚有余温的身体在地上弹了一下，便再无声息。
一时间，空气仿佛都凝固了。
那群皇城司的成员个个脸色煞白，握着刀柄的手不住地颤抖，却无一人敢上前一步。
赵全四人更是如遭雷击，呆立当场，嘴巴张得能塞进一个鸡蛋。
“带着他的尸体，滚。”
楚天渊冰冷的目光扫过那群皇城司的人，声音不大，却带着金戈铁马的杀伐之气，“再敢来我镇北王府门前聒噪，本王不介意让这京城的皇城司来个大清洗！”
此话一出，那群皇城司之人心头猛地一颤，完全不敢多言一句，几人手忙脚乱地抬起姜峰那具瘫软的尸体，连滚带爬地消失在了街角。
楚天渊这才将目光转向赵全四人，眼神冷得像腊月的寒冰：“你们还不滚？是想让镇北王府，也给你们备一口棺材么？”
不等四人回话，周围的百姓早已炸开了锅。
“教出那种人渣儿子，还有脸来王府门口哭丧？真是滑天下之大稽！”
“没错！
儿子都那副德性了，当爹的能是什么好东西？我看就该一并查了！”
“砸死这帮不要脸的老东西！”

不知是谁先吼了一句，紧接着，烂菜叶、臭鸡蛋、甚至脱下来的破鞋，如同雨点般朝着赵全四人砸了过去。
四位平日里高高在上的权贵，此刻被砸得满头满脸都是污秽，狼狈不堪，他们带来的家仆手忙脚乱地用袖子遮挡，却根本挡不住百姓的怒火。
“走，快走！”
赵全尖叫一声，也顾不上什么脸面了，带着人抬起那四口空棺材，在一片咒骂和投掷物中，灰溜溜地逃离了现场。
一场闹剧，就此收场。
楚天渊这才回头，瞥了一眼身旁的楚风：“你小子，长进了啊，居然还留了这么一手。”
“那是，也不看看我是谁的孙子。”
楚风嘿嘿一笑，顺势拍了个马屁。
他早在动手前就想好了对策，作为前身的狗腿子，那四个家伙的龌龊事，他脑子里存得明明白白，随便抖搂几件出来，就够他们喝一壶的。
“少贫嘴。”
楚天渊哼了一声，眼神却锐利起来，“说，你为何非要杀他们？”
“他们该死。”
楚风撇了撇嘴，不想多谈，话锋一转，脸上立刻堆起了讨好的笑容，“那个，爷爷，这事了了，您就别管了。”
“对了，孙儿最近想买点东西，手头有点紧，您看是不是……”
“要多少？”
楚天渊眼皮都没抬一下。
“不多不多，”
楚风伸出几根手指比划了一下，一脸轻松地说道：“随便给个几千万两，就行！”
content_en:
Click!
A clear and harsh sound of bone cracking suddenly sounded in front of the dead palace door.
As soon as Jiang Feng uttered a word, his voice suddenly stopped.
His eyes bulged, almost squeezed out of their sockets, filled with horror and confusion.
Chu Tianyuan's big hand, covered with thick calluses and like dry tree bark, was seen squeezing his neck.
That hand looked old, but it contained the unshakable power of a mountain, easily crushing his throat bone.
Bang!
Chu Tianyuan raised his arm and threw Jiang Feng's body on the ground with a muffled sound. The still warm body bounced on the ground and made no sound again.
For a moment, the air seemed to freeze.
The members of the Imperial City Division all turned pale, and the hands holding the handles of the swords were trembling, but no one dared to take a step forward.
The four of them, Zhao Quan and others, felt as if they were struck by lightning. They stood stunned on the spot, with their mouths open wide enough to stuff an egg.
"Take his body and get out."
Chu Tianyuan's cold eyes swept across the group of people from the Imperial City Department. His voice was not loud, but he had the killing intent of a fierce and powerful horse. "If you dare to come and make noise in front of my Zhenbei Prince's Mansion again, I don't mind letting the Imperial City Department of this capital have a big purge!"
As soon as these words came out, the hearts of the people in the Imperial City trembled suddenly, and they did not dare to say a word at all. Several people hurriedly lifted Jiang Feng's limp body and rolled and disappeared around the corner of the street.
Chu Tianyuan then turned his gaze to Zhao Quan and the others, his eyes as cold as the ice of the twelfth lunar month: "Are you still going away? Do you want Zhenbei Palace to prepare a coffin for you?"
Before the four people could reply, the people around them had already exploded.
"You raised such a scumbag son, and you still have the nerve to come to the gate of the palace to mourn? It's really the most ridiculous thing in the world!"
"That's right!
His son already has such virtue, how can he be a good father? I think it’s time to check them all! "
"Smash these shameless old guys to death!"
I don't know who yelled first, and then, rotten vegetable leaves, rotten eggs, and even broken shoes that had been taken off were thrown at Zhao Quan and the others like raindrops.
The four normally aloof dignitaries were now smashed with filth all over their heads and faces, and were in a state of utter disarray. The servants they brought with them hurriedly covered themselves up with their sleeves, but they could not block the anger of the people at all.
"Go, go quickly!"
Zhao Quan screamed, and without caring about his face, he led his men to lift the four empty coffins, and fled the scene in despair amidst the curses and throwing objects.
A farce ended here.
Chu Tianyuan then turned around and glanced at Chu Feng beside him: "You boy, you have grown so much that you still have such a hand."
"That's right, it doesn't matter whose grandson I am."
Chu Feng chuckled and flattered him.
He had already thought of a countermeasure before taking action. As the former scoundrel, he had clearly kept the dirty deeds of those four guys in his mind, and just throwing out a few of them would be enough for them to drink.
"Stop talking so much."
Chu Tianyuan snorted, but his eyes sharpened, "Tell me, why do you have to kill them?"
"They deserve to die."
Chu Feng curled his lips and didn't want to talk any more. As soon as the topic changed, a flattering smile appeared on his face, "Well, grandpa, this matter is over, so you can leave it alone."
"By the way, my grandson wants to buy something recently, and money is a little tight. Do you think..."
"How much?"
Chu Tianyuan didn't even raise his eyelids.
"No more, no more,"
Chu Feng stretched out a few fingers to make a gesture, and said with a relaxed expression: "Just give me a few tens of millions of taels, that's all!"
